title: NOAA APT Scheduled Pass Miss Rate
dataSources: FT8 spots (`ft8:spot`), JS8Call messages (`js8call:message`), PSKReporter receptions (`pskreporter:spot`), Direwolf TNC telemetry (`direwolf:packet`), and NOAA APT pass events (`noaaapt:pass`).
app: Weak-signal and decoder telemetry from WSJT-X FT8, JS8Call, PSKReporter, Direwolf TNC, NOAA APT pass schedulers, and station-control scripts sent to Splunk HEC via APIs, ADIF/log exports, and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=noaaapt:pass
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as attempts count(eval(captured="true")) as successful by _time satellite
| eval success_pct=if(attempts>0,round(100*successful/attempts,1),0)
| sort - _time
description: Tracks success rate for scheduled NOAA APT captures by satellite.
value: Missed scheduled passes often reveal rotator, scheduler, or SDR availability issues rather than propagation problems.
implementation: Capture explicit outcome states for scheduled NOAA APT captures events in `index=personal` and review both attempts and success percentage over time.
visualization: Time chart of success percentage for scheduled NOAA APT captures by satellite.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers how often scheduled NOAA APT captures works the way you expect instead of quietly failing.
